source.title: Oh, My Bleeding Hearts!
source.description:
I assume you are well acclimated to the Plaguelands given the impressive taint present on your specimens. It only stands to reason that you understand how inconvenient it is for any lone member of the Royal Apothecary Society to cross the Bulwark for supplies.

Renferrel claims to have an interest in bleeding hearts, the flower, in addition to once-beating hearts. I am unsure whether it is for alchemical research or their visual appeal, but I know he would appreciate a delivery of various hearts.
source.objective: Deliver the Basket of Discolored Beast Hearts and some Plaguelands Bleeding Hearts to Apothecary Renferrel in the Sepulcher of Silverpine Forest.
source.progress:
Am I expecting a delivery?

<Apothecary Renferrel checks his notes.>

You don't look like the test subject I requested...
source.completion:
Oh. My bleeding hearts. After months of waiting for Faranell to come through, it finally arrives after I long since abandoned that research. Terrific.

My intrigue is piqued by what's in this basket of yours, however. I am reminded of the hearts from local worgs, except these appear to be much more durable against blight and corruption.

Here, this recipe is inspired by an older concoction I developed in the past. Try it out and let me know how it goes.
